name: qualification-funnel
description: Production-minded disability benefits qualification funnel with Meta Pixel + CAPI, n8n automation and Airtable persistence.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @funnel/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @funnel/shared && npm run build --workspace @funnel/api && npm run build --workspace @funnel/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
